anova: Classic F and Welch F are both reported. Primary inference Welch if median Levene p<0.05.
eta: Eta-square is classical SSB/SST; it is not Welch-specific.
posthoc: Games-Howell uses q=abs(mean1-mean2)/sqrt(0.5*(s1²/n1+s2²/n2)); family-wise p from studentized range.
small_groups: Groups with n>=2 retained (source requirement). Interpret very small categories cautiously; do not generalize.
